title: Guilds of Ravnica Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Oh, you fellas are going to love the lockup. Excellent gruel. Very low ceilings." —Libuse, Boros sergeant
"To wage war, secure peace within yourself." —Emmara
The angels appreciated the offer but politely declined to eat any birdseed.
Beneath Ravnica's streets runs a layer of tunnels, then caverns and waterways, then terrors and nightmares.
"What bait do you cast to catch a dream?" —Ravnican riddle
"My greatest creation—me!"
"We have intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence. Until we're sure, no venture succeeds." —Lazav
The sound of every twisted secret tempts you to hear another.
"Variety is also the spice of death." —Cevraya, Golgari shaman
No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.
The assassins of the Ochran distill toxins from the remains of their previous victims.
Only the patrol's armor was found, so tainted with the acrid smell of sudden death that it could never be worn again.
Some storms never blow over.
Turns out coffee is the weird aunt of invention.
"The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."
"I am the very soul of battle, but even I would never advise open war with the Conclave." —Aurelia
Golgari crops bloom in strange soils, touched only by long-traveled light.
A power vacuum for the Azorius. A keepsake for Vraska.
"Commander, what's the signal to attack?" "You'll know."
"Whatever hatred destroys, a single act of trust can revive."
"Countermagic is a simple process of breaking matter into its elementary particles."
A swiftblade is an artist, each fiery trail of their blades a fleeting masterpiece traced on the air.
"It's truly the highest honor, isn't it? To be remembered? Pity for you."
Ral's storm crackled with mystical detections: Planeswalkers were infiltrating Ravnica.
"You've strayed, overworlder."
A well-chosen word can restore a mind or snap its tethers.
By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.
Cradle of the Golgari's new kingdom. Grave of those who wronged its queen.
"You will not be trained here. You will be forged." —Commander Yaszen
"A massive new Izzet building project with an unstated purpose? Probably fine." —Zija, Simic mutationist
"Where the roots reach, there the temple rises." —Niszka, Selesnya evangel
Few believe Duskmantle exists. Fewer find it. None live to bear witness.
